name: Grade 6 T1 Summative: Core Vocabulary
description: Ten core first-trimester words for the Grade 6 summative vocabulary table.

words.definition: A worldwide system that lets computers and people share information.
words.example: We use the internet to visit websites and send messages.

words.definition: A place online with pages of information.
words.example: The class opened a website about recycling.

words.definition: An app used to open websites.
words.example: A browser shows the web page on the screen.

words.definition: A name or number that helps find a place online.
words.example: A website address tells the browser where to go.

words.definition: The readable name of a website.
A system that helps match a website name to its online address.
words.example: DNS helps the browser find a website.

words.definition: A number address used by computers on a network.
words.example: A website server has an IP address.

words.definition: A small part of a message sent online.
words.example: A long message can travel as many packets.

words.definition: Information sent from one person or place to another.
words.example: The student sent a message to the group.

words.definition: A group of connected devices that can share information.
